quizName:
Hardest Questions in Michigan
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about an upcoming traffic signal. Get ready for yellow, red, or cross traffic.

questions.question: You must stop your vehicle when:

options.text: At an intersection with a stop sign.
A traffic officer tells you to stop.

questions.explanation: You must stop at stop signs, red lights, and when a traffic officer orders you to stop.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a road crosses ahead.

questions.question: When a funeral procession is present, ____ has the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: All drivers, pedestrians, and bicyclists must yield to funeral processions. When the lead vehicle enters an intersection, the rest of the procession can follow through, even if the traffic light is against them.

questions.question: Before turning, you should:
questions.explanation: Turn on your signal 3 to 4 seconds before you turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you can turn left on a green light, but you must yield to oncoming traffic first and only turn when it is safe.

questions.question: When approaching railroad tracks, you should:

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate closes.
Not worry about how many tracks you need to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Look, listen, slow down, and prepare to stop for trains or other vehicles on the tracks.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause a crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel

questions.explanation: Any distraction that makes you take your eyes off the road, hands off the wheel, or attention away from driving can cause a crash.

questions.question: You are borrowing an unfamiliar vehicle from a friend. You should:

options.text: Not worry because all vehicles are the same.
Not tell your friend you are unfamiliar with it.
Ignore any obvious problems to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Spend a few minutes learning where all controls are and how they work before you drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Spend a few minutes learning where all controls are and how they work before you drive.
questions.explanation: Learn where the turn signals, hazard lights, headlights, wipers, brakes, gear shift, and horn are located. Fix any problems before driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a school bus stopped with its stop arm out?

options.text: Stop completely and wait until it is safe to go.
Honk your horn and pass it on the left.
Keep driving when you think most children have left the bus.
Pass the bus before it opens its door.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and wait until it is safe to go.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop when a school bus has its stop arm out. Do not drive until the bus pulls in its stop arm.

questions.question: What should you do when driving on major highways?

options.text: Be ready to react to dangers on the road.

questions.explanation: On highways, you must stay alert and keep your eyes moving. This helps you avoid highway hypnosis. Always be ready to react quickly to hazards.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: You are upset from something that happened at work. When you get to your car, what should you do?

options.text: Play the radio loudly so you stop thinking about it.
Drive fast on the highway to feel better.
Wait a few minutes to calm down before you drive.
Go to a bar and have drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait a few minutes to calm down before you drive.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, take time to cool off before driving. Driving while emotional is dangerous to you and others on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. In this case, right turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does alcohol do to a driver?
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol harms your vision, judgment, focus, and coordination.

questions.question: What documents must you show if stopped by police or at an equipment check?
questions.explanation: You must carry and show your license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance. You are required to have all three of these documents when driving.

questions.question: What does this warning sign tell you?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings prepare you for road conditions ahead. This sign tells you that traffic may come from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid crashes.

questions.question: When you see an aggressive driver, what should you do?

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: Stay calm when facing an aggressive driver. Create distance between your vehicle and theirs. Slow down and let them pass. Do not make eye contact or make rude gestures.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even if no other traffic is around.
Signal only if other cars are nearby.
Signal only in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if no other traffic is around.
questions.explanation: Always use your signal when changing lanes, turning, or pulling away from the curb. This is the law. Do not skip signaling when you think no one is watching.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means no. This sign prohibits right turns. Do not turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Drive carefully to maintain control.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect you while driving?
questions.explanation: Alcohol affects the brain, impairing judgment and self-control. You may feel overconfident. Your reaction time, coordination, and balance suffer. Your vision and ability to judge distance worsen, making it hard to react safely.

questions.question: If you are in a serious crash, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Stop and move your vehicle off the road if possible. If anyone is hurt, call 911. Report the crash to police if there are injuries, deaths, or property damage over $1,000.

questions.question: What should you do if you see this sign?

options.text: You may pass a slow vehicle quickly.
You may pass if you know the road.
You may pass only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white rectangles with black markings. You must obey them. This sign prohibits passing. Do not pass other vehicles where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs control traffic movement and speed. You must obey them. This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make U-turns where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean stop. Come to a complete stop and yield to other traffic. Proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: Why is night driving more difficult than daytime driving?

options.text: Cars overheat more quickly at night.
You cannot see as far in the dark.
It rains more often at night.
You are more likely to see motorcycles at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot see as far in the dark.
questions.explanation: At night, you can see less far ahead. Always use your headlights. Drive slowly enough to stop within the distance you can see.

questions.question: What can cause distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on a phone.

questions.explanation: Drivers must make about 200 decisions for every mile they drive. Your full attention is needed for safe driving. Any extra activity can be dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: These parking spots are for people with disability permits.
Traffic must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and vehicles with multiple people.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spots are for people with disability permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disability permits.

questions.question: You miss your exit on a freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Turn quickly from your current lane.
Keep driving until the next safe turn or exit where you can turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep driving until the next safe turn or exit where you can turn around.
questions.explanation: If you miss your exit, do not back up. Go to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around. Backing up on a freeway or shoulder is illegal.

questions.question: When should you NOT pass another vehicle?

options.text: When there is a solid yellow line.

questions.explanation: Do not pass when it could endanger you or others. Avoid passing in no-passing zones, where you cannot see clearly, or when oncoming traffic is close.

questions.question: What can affect a person's ability to drive safely?
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires being in good health. Driving ability can be affected by alcohol, drugs, and tiredness.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means an action is not permitted. U-turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign tells you a railroad crossing is coming. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. It means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: You should slow down in these situations:

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, near intersections, near railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp or blind curves, where there are pedestrians or hazards, and when roads are wet or slippery.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver is behind you, what should you do?

options.text: Try to get out of the aggressive driver's way.
Stare at the driver as he or she passes you.
Speed up as he or she is passing you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Try to get out of the aggressive driver's way.
questions.explanation: If you see an aggressive driver, get out of their way. Do not make eye contact. Do not speed up, as this may make them angrier and more dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: You missed your freeway exit. What should you do?

options.text: Make a U-turn through the median.
Pull onto the shoulder and back your car to the exit.
Flag down a police officer for an escort back to your exit.

questions.explanation: If you miss your exit, take the next one. Do not stop, back up, or cross the median on a highway. These actions are illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: Who must wear a seat belt?

options.text: Any child under the age of 16.

questions.explanation: The driver, all front seat passengers, and any child under 16 must wear a seat belt in a moving vehicle. Police can stop you if anyone is not properly buckled up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers which direction they must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts drivers to watch for bicycles crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a school zone is coming up. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that there is a traffic signal at the next intersection.
